{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of March – July 2010. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries]]. On 18 February 2010 the Players Committee set "a March 15th 2010 release date (tournament legal 14 days later)"; it posted the release on 12 March, and the PDF has official text as of 15 March 2010.<ref name="hp201003">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (news item "Virtual Set: 6.3 Mercenaries – Details", 18 February 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100307212505/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 7 March 2010]</ref><ref name="hp201004">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (news item "Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!", 12 March 2010, and event calendar). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 9 April 2010]</ref><ref name="pdf63">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Mercenaries''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of March 15, 2010". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174429/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The planned legal date is therefore 29 March 2010; no announcement confirming it was found. The pool lasted until 1 July 2010; Virtual Block 7.1 became legal on 2 July.<ref name="j100">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=100:v71-ultimate-power&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 V7.1 Ultimate Power - Released!], Players Committee (15 June 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100713233029/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=100:v71-ultimate-power&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref> Event listings of the time call the format "Standard Contstructed" [sic].<ref name="hp201004" />

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–5 and Virtual Block 6.1–6.3
* '''In use:''' about 29 March 2010 (exact legal date not confirmed) – 1 July 2010
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|6.3 Mercenaries]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]] (110 cards).<ref name="w-r4">[[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 4, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Seventeen of the Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]; see [[Virtual Shields]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|6.2 Domain Of Evil]] (26 cards).<ref name="w-doe">[[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf62">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Domain Of Evil''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|6.3 Mercenaries]] (34 cards).<ref name="w-merc">[[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf63" />

Changes made while this pool was in force:

* 17 June 2010: errata to Death Star Gunner (V) and Rebel Tech (V), effective immediately: instead of canceling the game text of sites, they cancel the opponent's Force drain bonuses from those sites.<ref name="j102">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=102:errata-to-death-star-gunner-vrebel-tech-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Errata to Death Star Gunner (V)/Rebel Tech (V)], Players Committee (17 June 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025220/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=102:errata-to-death-star-gunner-vrebel-tech-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>

== History ==
The 18 February 2010 post explained that the planned February set had been pushed back and renamed Virtual Set 6.3: Mercenaries.<ref name="hp201003" /> Compared with [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]], the pool adds the 34 Mercenaries cards (21 Dark Side, 13 Light Side).<ref name="w-merc" /> Decklists of the [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (17–18 April 2010) already include Mercenaries cards such as [[Cyclone Walker]] and [[Cad Bane (Dark)|Cad Bane]].<ref name="ev-2010 Match Play Championship">Decklists of the [[2010 Match Play Championship]] on this wiki.</ref>

The Mercenaries PDF also describes an optional side format: "Block tournaments are a new and exciting kind of event ... You can select a limited number of virtual blocks to go along with any similar selection of Decipher expansions."<ref name="pdf63" /> Block tournaments were an alternative to this pool, not a replacement for it.
